--!native
-- Pure Luau helper for the place_on_cell workshop twin configuration, measured board, and calibrated camera.
-- Physics compliance parameters are provisional (so101_bench) and do not claim real-world hardware fidelity.
local Game = require(if script then script.Parent.Parent.Generated.Game else "../Generated/Game")
local T = require(if script then script.Parent.Parent.TicTacToe else "../TicTacToe")

local M = {}

M.taskName = Game.task or "place_on_cell"
M.provisionalPhysics = true
M.board = Game.board
M.camera = Game.camera
M.twinMeta = Game.twin_meta

-- Project a 3D point in spec robot frame {x, y, z} (m) into camera pixel coordinates {u, v}
-- using the calibrated pinhole + Brown-Conrady distortion model (r2p_camera/1).
function M.projectSpecToPixel(xyz)
    local cam = M.camera
    local R = cam.R
    local t = cam.t
    local K = cam.K
    local d = cam.dist or {0, 0, 0, 0, 0}

    local xc = R[1][1] * xyz[1] + R[1][2] * xyz[2] + R[1][3] * xyz[3] + t[1]
    local yc = R[2][1] * xyz[1] + R[2][2] * xyz[2] + R[2][3] * xyz[3] + t[2]
    local zc = R[3][1] * xyz[1] + R[3][2] * xyz[2] + R[3][3] * xyz[3] + t[3]
    assert(zc > 1e-6, "point behind camera")

    local x = xc / zc
    local y = yc / zc
    local r2 = x * x + y * y
    local r4 = r2 * r2
    local r6 = r4 * r2
    local radial = 1 + (d[1] or 0) * r2 + (d[2] or 0) * r4 + (d[5] or 0) * r6
    local p1 = d[3] or 0
    local p2 = d[4] or 0
    local xd = x * radial + 2 * p1 * x * y + p2 * (r2 + 2 * x * x)
    local yd = y * radial + p1 * (r2 + 2 * y * y) + 2 * p2 * x * y

    local u = K[1][1] * xd + K[1][2] * yd + K[1][3]
    local v = K[2][1] * xd + K[2][2] * yd + K[2][3]
    return {u, v}, zc
end

function M.nearestCell(xy, boardState)
    return T.nearest(M.board.cells, xy, boardState)
end

return M
